card.name: Cold Bloodlust
card.skill: [Counter: Play] If your Leader Card is ≪Frieza's Army≫, the Battle Card played has its skill negated for the duration of the turn.

qa.q: When can I activate a [Counter: Play] skill against an opponent’s skill that puts a Battle Card into play?
qa.a:
[Counter: Play] skills can be activated before and/or after the opponent resolves the skill that puts the Battle Card into play.
If you activate {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} after your opponent resolves the skill and puts their Battle Card into play, their Battle Card’s “when you play this card” skill(s) will still activate. If you want to prevent their “when you play this card” skill(s) from activating, you must activate {Cold Bloodlust} after your opponent activates their skill that puts the Battle Card into play, but before it resolves.

qa.q: When can you activate {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} against your opponent’s [Evolve] and/or [EX-Evolve] skills?
qa.a: [Counter: Play] skills can be activated before and/or after the opponent resolves the skill that puts the Battle Card into play. When your opponent activates and pays the cost for [Evolve] and/or [EX-Evolve], {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} can be activated either before they place the card(s) on top of the specified card(s), or after.

qa.q: When can you activate {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} against the auto skills on cards like {BT1-008 Bewitching God Vados}?
qa.a:
[Counter: Play] skills can be activated before and/or after the opponent resolves the skill that puts the Battle Card into play.
When your opponent activates {BT1-008 Bewitching God Vados}’s auto skill, [Counter: Play] can be activated before they look at the top three cards of their deck, or after they look at the top three cards of their deck, choose one, put it into play, and shuffle their deck.
If you activate {Cold Bloodlust} after the Battle Card comes into play, their Battle Card’s “when you play this card” skill(s) will still activate even though the original skill was negated. qa.q: When can you activate {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} against [Activate: Main] skills on cards like {BT2-043 Trunks, Creator of the Future}?
qa.a:
[Counter: Play] skills can be activated before and/or after the opponent resolves the skill that puts the Battle Card into play.
When your opponent activates and pays for {BT2-043 Trunks, Creator of the Future}’s [Activate: Main] skill, [Counter: Play] can be activated before they choose a card from their hand to put into play, or after your opponent chooses the card from their hand and puts it into play.
If you activate {Cold Bloodlust} after the Battle Card comes into play, their Battle Card’s “when you play this card” skill(s) will still activate even though the original skill was negated. If you want to prevent their “when you play this card” skill(s) from activating, you must activate {Cold Bloodlust} after your opponent activates their skill that puts the Battle Card into play, but before it resolves.

qa.q: When can you activate a [Counter] against your opponent’s [Counter]?
qa.a:
You can only activate it after your opponent activates their own [Counter] but before it resolves.
[Counter] skills are activated and resolved during a special timing window called counter timing, but it ends as soon as one [Counter] skill begins to resolve. Once counter timing ends, [Counter] skills can no longer be activated, which means that new [Counter] skills can’t be activated once a [Counter] finishes resolving.

qa.q: If {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} is activated in response to {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} being played, are {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods}’s skills negated?
qa.a:
Yes, they are.
{BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods}’s skill stopping its attacks and skills from being negated is applied when the card is in the Battle Area, but {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} negates its skills before the card is played.

qa.q: {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} is activated in response to {BT2-037 Determined Striker SSB Son Goku}’s [Counter: Attack] skill. Can {Determined Striker SSB Son Goku}’s [Counter: Attack] skill still be used to negate the attack?
qa.a:
Yes, {BT2-037 Determined Striker SSB Son Goku}’s [Counter: Attack] skill can still be used to negate the attack.
{BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} negates {BT2-037 Determined Striker SSB Son Goku}’s skills for the duration of the turn, but skills that have already been activated still resolve.

qa.q: Why can Cold Bloodlust negate {TB1-097 Son Goku, The Awakened Power}'s [Victory Strike]?
qa.a:
When {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} or {XD1-10 Frost's Deadly Poison} is activated during the first counter window, it can negate a Battle Card’s skills in the area it is in before it is played.
Cards like {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {TB1-097 Son Goku, The Awakened Power} have skills that say “[Permanent] This card's attack and skill cannot be negated,” but those skills are only active when those cards are in the Battle Area. Cards like {DB1-021 Ultra Instinct Son Goku, the Unstoppable} have skills that say “[Permanent] This card's skills can't be negated in any area by your opponent's skills.”, and those skills are always active, no matter what area the card is in, so they can’t be negated by a card like {Cold Bloodlust}.
Reference:
Official Rules 1-5-8:
If not specified otherwise, the skills (card text) of Leader Cards and Battle Cards are only relevant in the Leader Area and Battle Area.

card.name: Crusher Ball
card.skill: [Counter: Play] The Battle Card played is played in Rest Mode.

qa.q: When can I activate a [Counter: Play] skill against an opponent’s skill that puts a Battle Card into play?
qa.a:
[Counter: Play] skills can be activated before and/or after the opponent resolves the skill that puts the Battle Card into play.
{BT1-110 Crusher Ball} is a skill that treats the skill that put the card into play as the condition for forcing the card to enter play in Rest Mode, which means that activating {Crusher Ball} after your opponent has resolved the skill and put the card into play won’t allow you to put it into Rest Mode.
If you want your opponent’s Battle Card to enter play in Rest Mode, you have to activate {BT1-110 Crusher Ball} before your opponent activates and resolves the skill that puts the Battle Card into play.

qa.q: I activate {BT1-110 Crusher Ball} in response to the activation of a skill that mentions playing cards. If that skill plays multiple cards, does only one of the cards get put into play in Rest Mode?
